# Scene 10 harbor sprites

Generated with the built-in image_gen tool. Original transparent PNG outputs are preserved without bitmap edits. Cropped texture frames are registered in Phaser for consistent placement. Helicopter main rotor remains separately animated geometry.

Reference artwork: `../sailboat-small-v1.png` and `../../characters/chief-utopas-static-v1.png` (style only); the helicopter output was the shadow reference.

Files: `utopas-boat-pixel-v1.png`, `helicopter-pixel-v1.png`, `helicopter-shadow-pixel-v1.png`, `soldier-pixel-v1.png`, `warship-pixel-v1.png`.

## utopas-boat

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG game sprite for PETOA 16-bit Japanese RPG. Reference images are STYLE references only, not edit targets. Draw ONE empty small wooden island fishing boat, broadside slightly viewed from above, bow pointing right. Warm carved golden-brown planks, dark brown outline, subtle teal trim, interior floor visible and large open flat central deck to place character sprites on top. No sail, no mast, no cabin, no people, no cargo blocking deck. Match the chunky shaded pixels and hand-painted retro JRPG quality of the reference boat and old man, NOT flat geometric clipart. Approximately 128x72 logical pixels enlarged with sharp square pixels. Boat occupies almost all canvas with 5 percent transparent padding. Complete hull uncropped. Genuine transparent alpha background, no sea, no ground shadow, no scenery, no text, no labels, no watermark.

## helicopter

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: single transparent PNG helicopter body sprite for PETOA retro 16-bit JRPG. The reference character is only a pixel-art STYLE reference. ONE military utility helicopter, left-facing side view with a little top surface visible. Muted olive-green shaded metal, dark navy-brown pixel outlines, teal glass cockpit on LEFT, open dark side doorway near center-right, tail extending RIGHT with tail rotor, landing skids below. Main rotor mast on top but NO main rotor blades: main rotor animated separately in game. No rope or people. Handcrafted chunky 16-bit pixel art with roughly 160x80 logical pixels, crisp shaded square pixel clusters. Whole helicopter uncropped, 5 percent transparent padding. Genuine transparent alpha background. No background, cast shadow, text, national insignia, watermark.

## soldier

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent PNG soldier sprite for PETOA 16-bit Japanese RPG. Reference old man is STYLE reference ONLY. Single full-body military infantry soldier standing facing LEFT in three-quarter side view, holding a rifle level pointing left. Rounded olive helmet, muted olive uniform, dark boots, small tan face, hands gripping rifle. Match reference old man's scale and chibi proportions: large head, short body, about 48x64 logical pixels, crisp dark outline, shaded square pixel clusters, classic hand-painted JRPG sprite. Entire rifle and boots visible; muzzle at left around mid-body height. No extra poses, no sheet, blood, flash or rope. Tight framing with 5 percent transparent margins; genuine transparent alpha background, no floor, cast shadow, text or labels.

## warship

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent PNG distant military warship sprite for PETOA 16-bit Japanese RPG. Reference boat is STYLE reference only. Long modern gray-green naval warship, broadside profile with slight top-down visibility, bow pointing RIGHT. Clear angular hull, tiered bridge, radar mast, one forward naval gun, dark teal shadows and pale steel highlights. Crisp dark pixel outline, chunky shaded pixel clusters, roughly 192x80 logical pixels enlarged, richly crafted retro JRPG pixel art rather than flat geometric clipart. Ship occupies frame with 5 percent transparent padding, whole mast and hull uncropped. No people, ocean, waves, wake, background, text, flags, real insignia or watermark. Genuine transparent alpha background.

## shadow

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE transparent PNG cast-shadow sprite for a helicopter in a top-down 16-bit JRPG. Reference is the helicopter whose SHADOW is needed, not a scene to copy. Draw its single overhead silhouette, nose toward LEFT and long tail toward RIGHT, top-down body and four fully extended main rotor blades forming a wide cross at the body center. All pixels in silhouette uniform solid very dark navy; no interior features, highlights, texture or lighting. Crisp chunky pixel stair-step edges. Horizontally broad composition. Whole silhouette visible with 5 percent transparent padding. Genuine transparent alpha outside silhouette, no ground, no aircraft colors, no text. Used at reduced opacity on game water.
